_note: Art that isn't a catalog item: the farmer avatar's poses and the menu icons. tools/make_art_manifest.py turns this (plus collections, mystery eggs, the Mystery Box and ribbons) into art/manifest.json entries.

farmers.farmer_m: a friendly young farmer man with short brown hair, a red plaid shirt with rolled-up sleeves, blue denim overalls, brown work boots and a woven straw hat
farmers.farmer_f: a friendly young farmer woman with a brown ponytail, a yellow gingham shirt with rolled-up sleeves, blue denim overalls, brown work boots and a woven straw sun hat

poses.idle: standing relaxed with arms at the sides, smiling
poses.walk_a: walking, mid-stride with the left foot forward and arms swinging
poses.walk_b: walking, mid-stride with the right foot forward and arms swinging
poses.hoe: swinging a wooden hoe down into the ground with both hands, plowing
poses.plant: crouching down and sprinkling seeds from one hand onto the ground
poses.harvest: bending forward to pick crops, holding a woven wicker basket

facings.front: facing toward the bottom-right of the picture, toward the viewer (front three-quarter view)
facings.back: facing away toward the top-left of the picture (back three-quarter view, we see the back of the farmer)

icons.coins: a small stack of shiny gold coins
icons.fuel: a red metal jerry can of fuel
icons.plow: a wooden-handled steel farm plow blade
icons.seeds: a small burlap seed bag spilling a few seeds
icons.fertilizer: a sack of fertilizer with a green leaf on it
icons.fertilize_all: a big sack of fertilizer with golden sparkles around it
icons.unwither: a blue watering can with magic sparkles
icons.sell: a gold coin with a little paper price tag tied on
icons.rotate: two curved green arrows chasing each other in a circle
icons.market: a little red-and-white striped market stall with crates of produce
icons.farmhand: a straw hat and a pitchfork crossed together
icons.arborist: a pair of green-handled pruning shears
icons.queen_bee: a cute queen honey bee wearing a tiny golden crown
icons.truffle: a dark knobbly truffle on a green leaf
icons.bushel: an empty woven wicker bushel basket
icons.goods: a woven basket with a loaf of bread, a wine bottle and a candle
icons.gift: a wrapped present box with a red ribbon and bow
icons.collection: an open wooden keepsake box with small treasures inside
icons.ribbon_book: a green scrapbook with prize ribbons pinned on the cover
icons.mastery: a wooden farm sign with three gold stars on it
icons.expand: a wooden fence post with a measuring tape around it
icons.storage: a red barn door with a padlock
